name: Nordic stave church
summary: The tarred-timber palette and stone base say stave church, but the roof is one big uniform deepslate pyramid with the upper tiers and dragon heads stuck on top, so it reads as a heavy lid on a boxy hall rather than a stack of steep shingled roofs.
